items.title: OMS UI (order management web app)
evidence: Elena made 64% of the changes to oms-ui in the last 6 months. Three other people commit to it.
There is no runbook. When the order list breaks in production, Elena fixes it.
Only Elena has changed src/app/checkout/ in the last year.
oms-ui is written in TypeScript 86% (Angular) and SCSS 14%.

items.title: Weekly OMS UI release
evidence: Elena ran 11 of the last 12 Tuesday releases by hand.
The release steps are not written down anywhere.

items.title: Required reviewer for checkout code in oms-ui
evidence: CODEOWNERS makes Elena the only required reviewer for src/app/checkout/.
Once her account is closed, nobody can approve checkout changes.

items.title: OMS UI on-call (weekdays)
evidence: Elena is on the weekday OMS UI rotation. She handled 7 alerts in the last 90 days, mostly slow order search.

items.title: Open OMS tickets assigned to Elena
evidence: OMS-214 (In progress): Order search takes 8 seconds for large customers.
OMS-220 (To do): Upgrade Angular before the old version loses support in March.

items.title: OMS UI setup guide
evidence: A setup guide covers local install, environment variables and running tests. It is up to date.

items.title: Grace Holloway (Order Operations lead)
evidence: Weekly 30-minute meeting between Elena and Grace Holloway to agree which OMS fixes go in the next release.
